title: Console: offer a scan affordance on text and lookup fields when the mobile shell exposes `scan()`
body:
repo:mobile#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnW1Xf6HDSWz1eGAqv

Filing category ③: a direct task from the maintainer's card. objectstack-ai/mobile#146 says, verbatim: "Follow-up: after acceptance, the seat files the Console consumer card in objectstack-ai/objectstack (a scan affordance on text/lookup fields when `has('scan')`)."

## What the shell now offers

The shell side merged as objectstack-ai/mobile#170, into mobile `main` at `92a0a26`. The bridge contract lives in mobile `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md`, section "Scanning codes".

- The call is `window.ObjectStackNative.scan(opts?: { formats?: string[] }): Promise<string | null>`. Feature-detect it with `has('scan')`.
- The shell opens its native full-screen scanner, with torch and close.
  - The call resolves to the decoded text, or `null` when the user closes the scanner.
  - It fails with `failed` "Camera permission denied", or with `failed` "A scan is already open" if a second call arrives while one is open.
  - Bad options are rejected with `bad_args`.
- `formats` takes expo-camera `BarcodeType` names (`qr`, `ean13`, `code128`, …). If you omit it, every listed format is read.
- Only pages on the configured server's origin can call it, the same rule as every bridge method.

## Ask (Console, `ui/`)

- When `has('scan')` is true, show a scan affordance on text fields and lookup fields. Tapping it calls `scan()`.
  - Text: insert the decoded value.
  - Lookup: search with the decoded value.
- `null` means the user cancelled, so do nothing.
- Show `failed` with the Console's existing error toast.
- No affordance in a plain browser, or in an older shell where `has('scan')` is false.

## Business reason

- Who benefits: field users entering asset tags, product barcodes or document codes on a phone.
- If not done: the shell capability ships with no caller, which is a declared-but-unused capability.

## Who acts

The `domain:ui` seat. Triage first-touch decides grade and area. Where to declare the affordance (a generic field-level block, not a product-named widget) is the UI lane's call under its contract rules.

## Duplicate check

2026-11-02, open and closed:

| Query | Hits | Relevant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `is:issue "has('scan')"` | 0 | 0 |
| `is:issue scan bridge console mobile field` | 4 | 0 (seat posts, a spec row, a registry) |
| `is:issue barcode scan lookup field` | 0 | 0 |
